R2O — Rivers to Oceans, Mumbai (2018).

Identity for a seafood restaurant: a gold 'R2O' monogram inside an ornate rope-and-anchor frame, a hand-drawn catalogue of the catch (cod, bass, lobster, mud crab, hamachi, scampi…), navy chef's-table menus, an 'Origins' fish index, comment cards and sugar pouches. From the rivers to the oceans, plated.

Restaurant identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·60.
